compatibility.summary: Store access-group members and subgroup members can approve only pending screens requesting their active site; the existing pairing code is still required. Member-approved screens are shared with the store group without personal ownership, preserving metric delivery after the approving employee leaves. Library adds canApprove metadata and eligible requests; existing admin and legacy approval remain supported. Player sync, manifests, ingestion and transfer contracts are unchanged; Android 0.15.3 updates setup wording only. All 256 Node and 101 Python regressions, store-approval/browser isolation checks, typecheck, lint and build pass; physical TV/Pi and signed APK installation remain unverified.
